sentences.text: Galactosialidosis and brain small vessel disease 6 with leukoencephalopathy are both linked to the gene CTSA in curated databases [e_b81e379bd26c] [e_97c36a357231].
Constellate computed that they share this causal gene, with confidence 0.9, the lowest of the two gene links [e_53a209f18884].
For galactosialidosis, a cherry red spot in the macula, a part of the eye, is a curated, very frequent feature [e_5c09bb5aa234].
Reduced beta-galactosidase activity is also listed for galactosialidosis, but with a low confidence of 0.5 [e_a57e51d7c163].
These edges list no symptoms for brain small vessel disease 6 [e_97c36a357231].
They also show no studies, funding or patient groups for either disease [e_b81e379bd26c].
